subject: syn flood on server running shiny-server

messages.author: 4a86d6a0cc12009d
messages.subject: syn flood on server running shiny-server
parts:
Hi

 I have a set of shiny apps running on a virtual server (hosted at digital ocean).

Today I was running a workshop where 8-10 users were hitting my apps fairly regularly for a couple of hours.  At the end of this time, I received notice from digital ocean that my server instance was frozen due to an outbound SYN flood.  

The only services I'm running are opensshd, apache, shiny server, and tightvncserver.

Does anybody know if there's a way that users interacting with shiny server might cause this situation?  Or did my server coincidentally get compromised at the same time I was running the workshop?

Thanks,
Allan
